# ── Agent Identity ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[agent]
# [HI] Original: "this agent is named ..."
name = "[Agent Name]"
# [HI] Original: "version ..."
version = "1.0.0"
# [PP] Original: "..."
description = "[one-line summary]"

# ── Language Model ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[llm]
# [HI] Original: "use claude-sonnet-..."
model = "claude-sonnet-4-20250514"
# [EQ] Original: "temperature 0.7"
temperature = 0.7
# [EQ] Original: "max N tokens"
max_tokens = 1000
# [EQ] Original: "wait up to 30 seconds"  (unit: seconds)
timeout = 30

# ── Limits & Thresholds ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[limits]
# [EQ] Original: "retry at most 3 times"
max_retries = 3
# [EQ] Original: "show up to 5 results"
max_results = 5
# [EQ] Original: "keep the last 20 turns"
context_window_turns = 20

# ── Behavior Policies ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[behavior]
# [BA] Original: "always use a professional tone"
# Valid values: "professional" | "casual" | "neutral" | "empathetic"
tone = "professional"
# [BA] Original: "keep responses concise"
# Valid values: "concise" | "balanced" | "thorough"
verbosity = "concise"
# [BA] Original: "if unsure, ask for clarification"
# Valid values: "ask" | "attempt" | "escalate"
uncertainty_action = "ask"
# [BA] Original: "proactively suggest next steps"
suggest_next_steps = true
# [BA] Original: "always confirm before deleting"
require_delete_confirm = true

# ── Locale ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[locale]
# [EA] Original: "respond in Traditional Chinese"  (BCP 47)
language = "zh-TW"
# [EA] Original: "assume Asia/Taipei timezone"  (IANA tz)
timezone = "Asia/Taipei"
# [EA] Original: "format dates as YYYY-MM-DD"
date_format = "YYYY-MM-DD"
# [EA] Original: "assume users are in Taiwan"  (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)
region = "TW"

# ── Output Format ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[format]
# [EA] Original: "format all output as Markdown"
# Valid values: "markdown" | "plaintext" | "json"
output = "markdown"
# [EA] Original: "render tables where appropriate"
use_tables = true
# [EA] Original: "use code blocks for all code"
code_blocks = true

# ── Persona ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[persona]
# [PP] Original: "be direct and get to the point"
# Valid values: "direct" | "explanatory" | "collaborative"
style = "direct"
# [PP] Original: "maintain professional register"
# Valid values: "professional" | "neutral" | "casual"
formality = "professional"
# [PP] Original: "..."
# Valid values: "beginner" | "intermediate" | "expert" | "adaptive"
assumed_user_level = "intermediate"
# [PP] Original: "use examples to illustrate"
use_examples = true
# [PP] Original: "ask one question at a time"
questions_per_turn = 1

# ── Paths ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[paths]
# [HI] Original: "save output to output.md"
output_file = "output.md"
